text: You want to know if the digital camera you just bought is 10x zoom. If not, modify the item to 10x zoom without changing the other options. If 10x zoom is not available, cancel the order with the reason of no longer needed. If it is available but the price is more than 3000, cancel the order with the reason of ordered by mistake.
zh: 您想知道您刚买的数码相机是否有10倍变焦。如果没有，请将商品修改为10倍变焦，其他选项不变。如果10倍变焦不可用，请以“不再需要”为原因取消订单。如果可用但价格超过3000，请以“订购错误”为原因取消订单。(#W1234567, 商品编号, 数码相机)
